turns.assessment: No corroborating symptom was found at or after the stated onset. Both ends of the direct S03–S10 lightpath (och51) report unchanged receive power, OSNR, pre-FEC BER, DGD, SOP rate, and laser bias, while svc344 uses the same working lightpath without degradation. This strongly argues against an optical-path, ROADM, amplifier, span, or shared line-interface fault. A service-specific endpoint problem is conceivable, but the documented client-port failure mode predicts interruption rather than the unconfirmed quality degradation, so the cause is not established.

proposals.rationale: An endpoint client-port fault could uniquely affect svc195 while leaving svc344 and other services normal. However, this mode should produce CLIENT_DOWN, and no corresponding symptom was observed.

Receiver-local degradation at S10 could reduce quality without changing the optical path, but unchanged pre-FEC BER and other receiver metrics directly oppose it; another service on och51 is also normal.
Receiver-local degradation at S03 is directionally possible, but all monitored receiver metrics remained unchanged and the shared lightpath carries an unaffected service.

score.why: cause flagged as unconsidered and absent
